name: dotbrain
description: Keeps your project's context private and your code repo clean.

interface.shortDescription: Private project context, loaded every session
interface.longDescription: Your project's decisions, domain vocabulary, and design rationale live in a private Brain outside the code repo, and reach every session automatically — so you stop re-explaining the project and it never leaks into a public repo. Bundled with engineering skills for design docs, decision records, and issue tracking.
defaultPrompt: What am I missing before I start?
Turn this plan into a design doc and issues.
